description: Acquisition ID. The mid-date of stem measurements within the site for that data collection event.
The taxonomic name of the tree. Matching the stem measurement table.
The family name of the taxon.
The genus name of the taxon.
The specific epithet of the taxon. E.g. “africana” for species Burkea africana.
The subspecies epithet of the taxon. E.g. “pannosum” for Helianthemum pannosum subsp. pannosum.
The variety epithet of the taxon. E.g. “leucophloea” for Vachellia leucophloea var. leucophloea.
